sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The shared MusicBrainz request gate (mbu:mb-gate, shared with majkinetor's scripts) can no longer hang a request behind a Web Lock that never answers: after 3 s the booking goes ahead without the lock, and a lock granted later books nothing a second time (ported from his dev/net/mb-gate.mjs).

A hold stored in the shared gate counts for at most 60 s from the moment the page first saw it, both when a request is booked and while it waits, so a broken or far-future hold can no longer stall the page's MusicBrainz requests for minutes.

Waits in the shared gate now end on time even when the browser holds the page's timers back (seen in Firefox with Violentmonkey): they also wake on animation frames, page changes and a worker's timer, and all of that stops as soon as nothing waits (ported from his mbnSleep, #999).
The Relationships column's job log now says that a wait is a hold MusicBrainz asked for, not pacing, and adds a line when a new hold makes the wait longer.
